subject: Post-call: AuroraPay security & evidence sprint plan
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Mike Chen <mike.chen@aurorapay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: AuroraPay security & evidence sprint plan

Thanks for the time today, Mike and Sarah — good conversation. Quick recap + proposed sprint to close the security qualification items so your procurement team can move to commercial review.

Key pain points you called out
- Retention and audit log access: need a clear retention window and an exportable audit log for regulatory reporting.
- SOC 2 scope and artifacts: procurement asked for evidence for in-scope controls (logging, change management, access reviews).
- DPA & MPA redlines: legal expects a few edits (data residency & subprocessor list).
- Pen test / vuln scan proof: you need a recent pen test summary and remediation timeline.

Goals we aligned on
1) Provide a compact evidence pack for initial procurement review (SOC 2 summary, audit log sample, DPA markups, pen test summary). Target date: 2027-09-13.
2) Map required evidence to AuroraPay's control checklist so your InfoSec can validate quickly. Target date: 2027-09-09.
3) Create an acceptance note that ties Redwood's retention + export capabilities to your regulatory needs — include options for extended retention (archival) if required.

Concrete next steps (owners & dates)
- Redwood to share: SOC 2 one-page summary, evidence mapping template, pen-test summary stub, and proposed DPA edits. (Owner: me) — item due 2027-09-07. Attachment: redwood-soc2-quicksheet.pdf, evidence-mapping-template.xlsx, proposed-mpa-dpa-text.docx
- AuroraPay to confirm: list of regulatory retention periods, example audit queries you need, and preferred jurisdiction for data processing (US / EU). (Owner: Mike) — due 2027-09-09.
- Quick sync: 30-min follow-up to review the mapping and any DPA redlines. Proposed slots: 2027-09-10 or 2027-09-13. (Owner: mutual)

Risks & open items
- If the DPA redlines are extensive we may need legal time which can push timelines; flag early if you expect major edits.
- Pen test full report is scoped to customers under an NDA; we'll provide a summary and offer controlled access to full report under an auditor NDA.

If that aligns, I'll send the files referenced above and a calendar invite for a follow-up review with Laura (on compliance) and Aditya (solutions).

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments referenced (stubs):
- redwood-soc2-quicksheet.pdf (pdf, 1pg summary)
- evidence-mapping-template.xlsx (xlsx, mapping matrix)
- proposed-mpa-dpa-text.docx (docx, suggested clause edits)
From: Mike Chen <mike.chen@aurorapay.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Langston <sarah.langston@aurorapay.com>
Date: 2027-09-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: AuroraPay security & evidence sprint plan

Thanks, Irene — this is helpful. Quick clarifications: 
1) For retention we need a 7-year archival option for transaction metadata and a 1-year hot-access window for full payloads. Is that supported today or would that be an architecture change?
2) On pen tests, procurement will accept a summary but will want to see CVE timelines for critical/urgent items. Can Redwood provide that as part of the summary?
3) For the DPA, our legal is likely to push for EU data residency for EU customers. Can you confirm if Redwood can guarantee EU-only processing for tenant data?

Attaching our internal security checklist snapshot so you can map items back to our control IDs. (attachment: aurorapay-security-checklist-0906.pdf)

I can target the 9/9 deadline for the retention details. For the follow-up, 9/10 at 10am PT works for our team.

- Mike
Mike Chen
Head of IT Risk, AuroraPay
mike.chen@aurorapay.com | +1 206 555 0199

---
Attachment referenced: aurorapay-security-checklist-0906.pdf (pdf, internal checklist)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Mike Chen <mike.chen@aurorapay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-06T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: AuroraPay security & evidence sprint plan

Appreciate the checklist, Mike — that's perfect for mapping. Quick answers inline and next actions below.

Retention
- Hot window (1 year): supported natively via default storage tier; immediate exports and queries possible via our audit API.
- Archival (7 years): supported via optional cold-tier retention. This requires enabling archival retention on your tenant and will add a small monthly storage surcharge. We'll include the exact pricing delta in the commercial packet.

Pen test summary
- We can include CVE timelines for high/critical items in the summary. For full timelines and raw findings we require an Auditor NDA; if procurement prefers, we can provide a redacted timeline in the first pass.

EU-only processing
- Redwood offers region pinning for customer data in our Dedicated and Private modes. For Hosted we currently have EU processing available and can scope EU-only processing in the DPA (subject to technical and contractual confirmation). We'll note this as an action for legal.

Deliverables I'm attaching now (stubs) and will send final files by EOD 9/07:
- redwood-soc2-quicksheet.pdf (summary of scope + control owners)
- evidence-mapping-template.xlsx (pre-filled with common control mappings; please paste your control IDs into column B)
- proposed-mpa-dpa-text.docx (callout: data residency and subprocessors table to be completed)

Action items (updated)
- Redwood (Irene): Final evidence pack + redacted pen test timeline, and pricing note for archival retention — due 2027-09-07 EOD.
- AuroraPay (Mike): Confirm retention windows and send any additional controls that require special handling — due 2027-09-09.
- Follow-up review: 2027-09-10 10:00 PT (invite sent).

If you want me to include our audit log sample (csv export) in the first bundle, let me know — it helps verify the exact fields returned.

Thanks — see you Friday.
Irene
